verdict.rationale: Attio documents a first-party bulk record action extension point: actions appear when multiple record rows are selected in a list. Object-level actions for imports and syncs also support work across many items. However, these bulk actions must be built as App SDK extensions, and no native bulk-edit feature, bulk REST endpoint, or AI/MCP-driven bulk operation is evidenced. Missing for 10: native out-of-the-box bulk edit/update, bulk API endpoints, AI-driven bulk operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
